en.title: How AI Agents Are Replacing Administrative Tasks
en.summary: AI agents don't just answer questions — they execute tasks, make decisions, and operate autonomously. We explain what they are and where to start.

es.title: Cómo los AI Agents están reemplazando tareas administrativas
es.summary: Los AI agents no solo responden preguntas, ejecutan tareas, toman decisiones y operan de forma autónoma. Te explicamos qué son y por dónde empezar.
